penalties_range: Up to CNY 50M or 5% of prior-year turnover (serious cases); individuals CNY 100k-1M
deceased_data: Near relatives may access, copy, correct, delete deceased's data for their own lawful interests, unless the deceased arranged otherwise (art. 49)
research_exemption: No research-specific legal basis: consent is the main basis (art. 13); research not among non-consent grounds
genetic_data: Sensitive PI (art. 28 lists biometrics, health; genetic named in PI Security Specification): specific purpose, necessity, separate consent (arts. 28-30)
notes: PIPL unamended; audit measures (May 2025), cross-border certification (Jan 2026), CSL fines raised Jan 2026
